answer: The comet report publishes the merge explicitly at each opal. Each collapsed cluster gets one yarrow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. A 286 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
